proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the category of finitely presented schemes over S is the colimit over the S_i (limits lemma); invertible modules on X are the colimit of those on X_i (descend-modules and descend-invertible-modules lemmas); properness and flatness of X_i -> S_i hold eventually (eventually-proper, descend-flat-finite-presentation); ampleness of L_i eventually (limit-ample lemma); combining gives the fibre-category colimit identity (source lines 4290-4316)
